resources.title: Housing — Borås
resources.body: Numbeo data for Borås (Jun 2026) did not include a 1-bedroom city-centre rent figure (listed as unknown). Outside city-centre 1-BR was approximately 8,700 SEK/month. Based on regional averages for a mid-sized Swedish city, 1-BR city-centre rent is likely in the 7,000–9,000 SEK range. Main rental portals are blocket.se (now qasa.se) and hemnet.se.

resources.title: Banking — Borås
resources.body: Major Swedish banks in Borås include Swedbank, Handelsbanken, SEB, and Nordea. Borås is the fifth-largest city in Västra Götaland. To open an account newcomers need: valid passport or national ID, Swedish personnummer or samordningsnummer, proof of address, and sometimes proof of employment or income.

resources.title: Schools & childcare — Borås
resources.body: Borås is in Västra Götaland County. International school or IB-curriculum options within Borås itself are limited; the broader Gothenburg region (40 km away) has more extensive international schools. The Swedish national school directory (Skolverket) lists available schools. Västtrafik's Borås Mini periodbiljett is available for local transit.

resources.title: Registration & admin — Borås
resources.body: All persons moving to Sweden must register with Skatteverket via Folkbokföring (population registration) within 3 months. In Borås, this is done at a local Skatteverket service office. Required to receive a personnummer and access public services.

resources.title: Tax & finance — Borås
resources.body: Personnummer is assigned by Skatteverket upon Folkbokföring. It is a 10-digit personal identity number essential for banking, healthcare, employment, and tax matters in Sweden.

resources.title: Transport — Borås
resources.body: Public transport in Borås is operated by Västtrafik (the regional transit authority for Västra Götaland, website: vasttrafik.se). Västtrafik offers a Borås Mini periodbiljett (local Borås zone). Per Numbeo, monthly pass costs approximately 771 SEK (Jun 2026). EU/EEA driving licences are valid indefinitely in Sweden; non-EU licences valid 1 year after residency then must be exchanged. Healthcare via Västra Götalandsregionen vårdcentral.

resources.title: Housing — Gävle
resources.body: No verified Numbeo city-level rent data was found for Gävle (the city is too small for Numbeo's database). Based on Swedish regional averages and proximity to Stockholm, 1-bedroom city-centre rents are estimated in the 6,500–8,500 SEK/month range, but no direct verified figure could be confirmed from fetched sources. Main rental portals are blocket.se (now qasa.se) and hemnet.se.

resources.title: Banking — Gävle
resources.body: Major Swedish banks operating in Gävle include Swedbank, Handelsbanken, SEB, and Nordea. To open an account newcomers typically need: valid passport or national ID, Swedish personnummer or samordningsnummer, proof of address, and in some cases proof of employment or income.

resources.title: Schools & childcare — Gävle
resources.body: Gävle is in Gävleborg County. International school options within Gävle are limited; the Swedish national school directory (Skolverket) lists available schools. Families seeking IB or other international curricula may need to consider the broader region or distance education. No directly verified international school was found in Gävle from fetched sources.

Exact 30-day pass price was not retrieved from the pricing page (404 errors); Numbeo data for Gävle was unavailable. A half-price campaign on 30-day passes was running Jul–Dec 2026. EU/EEA driving licences valid indefinitely in Sweden; non-EU licences valid 1 year after residency then must be exchanged. Healthcare via Region Gävleborg vårdcentral.

resources.title: Housing — Jönköping
resources.body: Average rent for a 1-bedroom apartment in Jönköping city centre is approximately 9,000 SEK/month per Numbeo (Jun 2026). Deposit norm in Sweden is typically 1-3 months rent. Main rental portals are blocket.se (now qasa.se) and hemnet.se.

resources.title: Banking — Jönköping
resources.body: Major Swedish banks in Jönköping include Swedbank, Handelsbanken, SEB, and Nordea. To open an account newcomers need: valid passport or national ID, Swedish personnummer or samordningsnummer, proof of address, and sometimes proof of employment or income.

resources.title: Schools & childcare — Jönköping
resources.body: Jönköping is in Jönköping County. The city hosts Jönköping University and has a relatively international community. International schools and IB options exist in the region. The Swedish national school directory is at Skolverket.

resources.title: Registration & admin — Jönköping
resources.body: All persons moving to Sweden must register with Skatteverket via Folkbokföring (population registration) within 3 months. In Jönköping, this is done at a local Skatteverket service office. Required to obtain a personnummer and access public services.

resources.title: Tax & finance — Jönköping
resources.body: Personnummer is assigned by Skatteverket upon Folkbokföring. It is a 10-digit personal identity number essential for all interactions with public and private institutions in Sweden.

resources.title: Transport — Jönköping
resources.body: Public transport in Jönköping is operated by Jönköpings Länstrafik (JLT). The 30-day adult pass for 1 zone costs 815 SEK (standard price as of Jul 2026, per jlt.se). Note: a temporary half-price campaign (407 SEK) runs July–December 2026. EU/EEA driving licences valid indefinitely in Sweden; non-EU licences valid 1 year after residency then must be exchanged. Healthcare via Region Jönköpings Län vårdcentral.

resources.title: Housing — Norrköping
resources.body: Average rent for a 1-bedroom apartment in Norrköping city centre is approximately 6,684 SEK/month per Numbeo (Jun 2026). Deposit norm in Sweden is typically 1-3 months rent. Main rental portals are blocket.se (now qasa.se) and hemnet.se.

resources.title: Banking — Norrköping
resources.body: Major Swedish banks operating in Norrköping include Swedbank, Handelsbanken, SEB, and Nordea. To open an account newcomers typically need: valid passport or national ID, Swedish personnummer or samordningsnummer, proof of address, and in some cases proof of employment.

resources.title: Schools & childcare — Norrköping
resources.body: Norrköping is in Östergötland County. International school options include IB-curriculum schools in the Linköping-Norrköping region. No dedicated standalone international school was directly verified within Norrköping city; IB options are available in the broader Östergötland region and Linköping. The Swedish school directory is at Skolverket.

resources.title: Registration & admin — Norrköping
resources.body: All persons moving to Sweden must register with Skatteverket via Folkbokföring (population registration) within 3 months of arrival. This is done at a local Skatteverket service office. Registration is required to receive a personnummer and access to public services.

resources.title: Tax & finance — Norrköping
resources.body: Personnummer is assigned by Skatteverket upon completion of Folkbokföring. It is a 10-digit personal identity number essential for banking, healthcare, employment, and tax matters in Sweden.

resources.title: Transport — Norrköping
resources.body: Public transport in Norrköping is operated by Östgötatrafiken (the regional transit authority for Östergötland County). Norrköping has a city tram and bus network. 30-day pass for the stadszon (city zone) costs 795 SEK (standard adult price, as of Aug 2026 per ostgotatrafiken.se). EU/EEA driving licences are valid indefinitely in Sweden; non-EU licences valid 1 year after residency, then must be exchanged. Healthcare via Region Östergötland vårdcentral.
